info.title: Mirror
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [Mirror](#/Mirror)
[Mirror](#/Mirror) references for sessions configured in this bridge.

active.description: The intended state of the mirror session: active or inactive. The [operation_state](#/Mirror) value contains the actual state in hardware (e.g. active, inactive, or error). When missing or false, the state is inactive.

mirror_status.description: Key-value pair(s) that report mirror status in hardware.

operation_state.description: Operational state of the mirror session in hardware. Only the value "active" means the hardware mirroring is running. Any other value, or if the key is missing, means the session is not running.

origin.description: Origin of the Mirror, i.e., how the Mirror is provisioned:  `synthesized`: Mirror has been dynamically synthesized                 by the system.  `static`     : Mirror is provisioned by the administrator                 via CLI or REST.

output_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Ethernet port reference in [Port](#/Port) used to transmit the mirror packets. There must be a valid Ethernet port for the session operation state to become active. The output port should be reserved exclusively for transmitting mirror packets for this session. It should not participate in any other network activity (e.g. Spanning Tree, LACP etc).

select_dst_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Set of Ethernet port or LAG references in [Port](#/Port) on which transmitted packets are selected to be mirrored.

select_src_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Set of Ethernet port or LAG references in [Port](#/Port) on which received packets are selected to be mirrored.

session_type.description: Mirror Session output/destination type. 'none'         : session doesn't have defined destination 'port'         : session mirrors to the physical interface 'cpu'          : session mirrors to the internal CPU 'tunnel'       : session mirrors into a tunnel

tx_bytes.description: Number of bytes transmitted through this mirror.

tx_packets.description: Number of packets transmitted through this mirror.

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times statistics were cleared.

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times statistics were requested to be cleared.

tunnel.description: Tunnel parameters. Only considered if the session_type is 'tunnel'.

dest_ip_address.description: Destination IPv4 address of the tunnel.

dscp.description: DSCP to be marked on the tunneled packets.

src_ip_address.description: Source IPv4 address of the tunnel.

tunnel_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF to be used for reaching the tunnel destination IP address. If not specified, 'default' VRF will be used instead.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
